output.summary: The backlog growth is mostly self-generated by the quota. First-contact demand rose only 4%, while split children (240 to 3,710) and duplicates (410 to 2,770) exploded. Reopens tripled, and the config audit rules out a measurement artifact. Agents pick quick tickets, and the survey, Team C and the exempt Billing-Compliance pod all fit this. Capacity was flat and closes per agent rose, so effort and headcount are not the cause. Payroll volume is small. Resignations are confounded by a competitor pay offer and the deferred pay review. Engineering bugs may contribute, but that is unquantified. Avoid a tougher quota and the irreversible hiring. Suspend the quota in favor of quality measures and ticket ownership, and classify the aged complex tickets.
